name: rodParts
meaning: RodParts: rodClass = Always 0x43 (CLASSID_FISHINGROD), set by CompositeRod_InitParts; matched by msg 0x28 and reported by msg 0x6e; baitClass = Bait component class: 0x42 Magnet (MagnetRod_Init) or 3 Salad (SaladRod_Init); rod = The FishingRod object this composite was built from: set by msg 0x2A (the argument whose classId is 0x43), returned by 0x29, cleared by 0x2B and InitParts; bait = The Magnet or Salad object: added to the world and hung from rod joint 4 while fishing, positioned each frame by CompositeRod_Update, its attach matrix drives the drawn line; set/cleared by msgs 0x2A/0x2B
